Celsius RK2 Full Rack
Now $499.00 ^ Was $699.00
Ends 20/04/26

Allowing you to perform a range of different exercises like chin ups, pulls ups and various forms of weight training, the Celsius RK2 Full Rack is the perfect addition to your home gym. The adjustable safety bars allow you to quickly and easily customise to your height for greater safety when lifting. Constructed to be able to be bolted into the ground, you will experience superior stability.

  • Upper grips for chin ups and pull ups
  • Adjustable safety bars
  • Large walk in space
  • Barbell holder for storage solution
  • Can be bolted into ground for added support
  • Total max weight loading: 210kg
  • Max user weight: 135k
  • Max weight rest loading 150kg
  • Max long safety bar loading 150kg
  • 1 year warranty

2 out of 5 stars.

Far from perfect

2 months ago
Not bad. Sturdy eno8gh to do chin ups with my 92kg bw, but the item has poor quality control. The frame has surface rust inside that is visible. Im not sure about what i can't see which is concerning. I can't even get to it properly to give it a brush down with a wire brush and apply some cold gal. The stop bars are definitely too high fo benching unless your chest is 600mm deep, and theres no safety hooks for when youre applying plates. Im going to need to jerry rig something up to keep my standard bar in place while I put plates on. Sure, Olympic bar probably doesnt have this issue due to weight, but I've just shelled out some decent coin for this and not able to spend another 2k on Olympic bar and weights to compliment it yet. So yeah, long story short, its cheap because its made cheap.
LikesSimple To Use, Comfortable

Good product but room for improvement

4 years ago
Good beginner entry rack. If you plan on using this every day for the foreseeable future i wouldnt say this is a rack for you very limiting with the lack of holes to vary your trainig methods. Also a lack of accessories because of the size of the holes. I found myself growing out of it far quicker than i wouldve imagined. Another thing that bottom bar going from left to right is in a very awkward position as its right where you need to to stand to unrack weight when standing inside the cage. Overall good rack for its price point but is not without its flaws.
